en: A vintage-style postcard depicting a picturesque European city with red-tiled roofs, historic church steeples, a fortified castle-like building, and a waterfront featuring sailing ships on a wide river or bay. The architecture appears distinctly Baltic or Northern European, and the overall view is from an elevated perspective, seeming to look over the Old Town area toward the water. The lower right contains some barely discernible text.
